title: Logarithmic Differentiation
subtitle: Take ln of both sides to tame variable exponents and long products.

questions.text: When do you need logarithmic differentiation?
options: When the variable is in both the base and the exponent, like $x^x$
questions.explain: $x^5$ uses the power rule, $2^x$ uses the $b^x$ rule. $x^x$ needs the trick.
